outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of HMGB1 signal intensity (N=4, n>100 cells) but only shows bars with error bars, with no individual data points overlaid.
The lower graph shows mean ± SD of % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells (N=4, n>400) as bars with error bars only; no individual data points are displayed.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a quantitative plot showing averages, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot (time on rotarod across weeks) with mean ± SD; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points as overlay would make them unreadable.
Panel E consists of line plots showing rotarod performance over days at different ages; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a line plot type exempt from needing individual data points.
Panel G shows micrograph images of histology, not a plot displaying averaged data.
Both bar graphs in panel H (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number, N=3, n=9) show mean ± SD as bars with error bars but no individual data points are overlaid.
